title: The Uber Knight's Most Extreme
description: The Uber Knight's Most Extreme — The Townstons wiki
html:
The Uber Knight's Most Extreme is a named mythic set in the PartialBuiltMythic / seasonal PAL templates (Fighter palette).

Each piece sets SoulBound = true and a fixed base name. Rolled extra endings, if any: Mythic Suffixes.

Pieces:

  • The Uber Knight's Most Extreme Battle Suit — Body
  • The Uber Knight's Most Extreme Battle Spaulders — Shoulders
  • The Uber Knight's Most Extreme Battle Helm — Helm
  • The Uber Knight's Most Extreme Battle Gloves — Gloves
  • The Uber Knight's Most Extreme Battle Boots — Boots
  • The Uber Knight's Most Extreme Battle Shield — Shield
